from .solvers import solve_task


def run_factory(destination,*,count=24,seed=42,families=FAMILIES,sizes=(2,3,4),license_id,provenance,calibration=False,budget=1000000):
    if not isinstance(license_id,str) or not license_id.strip() or not isinstance(provenance,str) or not provenance.strip():
        raise ValueError('Licenca e procedencia obrigatorias')
    plan=list(sampling_plan(count,seed,tuple(families),tuple(sizes)))
    if calibration and count>128:
        raise ValueError('Calibracao limitada a 128 tentativas por benchmark')
    destination=Path(destination).absolute()
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.forge-v2-',dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        generated=[];index=SemanticIndex()
        for family,derived,size in plan:
            item=generate_task(family,derived,size)
            if index.add(item.task):
                generated.append(item)
        tasks=[item.task for item in generated]
        policy=SplitPolicy();assignment=assign_splits(tasks,policy)
        profile=calibrate(tasks,budget=budget) if calibration else None
        records=[];partitions={name:[] for name in ('train','validation','test')}
        for item in generated:
            task=item.task
            witness=build_trace(task,item.witness)
            candidate=solve_task(task)
            trace=build_trace(task,candidate)
            if not witness.to_data()['verification']['valid'] or not trace.to_data()['verification']['valid']:
                raise ArithmeticError('Construtor/solver rejeitado pelo verificador')
            row={'schema_version':2,'task':task.to_data(),'task_id':task.content_id,
                 'semantic_id':semantic_fingerprint(task),'seed':item.seed,'generator_version':'inverse-v2',
                 'witness_trace':witness.to_data(),'solution_trace':trace.to_data(),'split':assignment[task.content_id],
                 'license_id':license_id,'provenance':provenance,'synthetic':True,
                 'difficulty':profile['ratings'][task.content_id] if profile else {'label':'uncalibrated'},
                 'calibration_id':profile['calibration_id'] if profile else None}
            records.append(row);partitions[row['split']].append(row)
        for name,rows in [('records',records),*partitions.items()]:
            (stage/f'{name}.jsonl').write_text(''.join(canonical_json(r)+'\n' for r in rows),encoding='utf-8')
        report=index.report()
        report.update({'schema_version':2,'seed':seed,'count':count,'families_requested':list(families),'sizes_requested':list(sizes),
                       'license_id':license_id,'provenance':provenance,'split_policy':policy.to_data(),
                       'splits':{k:len(v) for k,v in partitions.items()},
                       'contamination':audit_splits({k:[TaskSpec.from_data(r['task']) for r in rows] for k,rows in partitions.items()}),
                       'calibration_id':profile['calibration_id'] if profile else None})
        (stage/'card.json').write_text(canonical_json(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        if profile:
            (stage/'calibration.json').write_text(canonical_json(profile)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        manifest={'schema_version':2,'files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(stage.iterdir())}}
        (stage/'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        if not verify_factory(stage):
            raise ArithmeticError('Bundle Forge v2 falhou na reexecucao')
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(destination)
        stage.rename(destination)
        return report
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify_factory(directory):
    try:
        root=Path(directory)
        manifest_path=root/'manifest.json'
        if manifest_path.is_symlink() or manifest_path.stat().st_size>1024*1024:
            return False
        manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if manifest['schema_version']!=2:
            return False
        actual={p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.name!='manifest.json'}
        if set(manifest['files'])!=actual:
            return False
        for name,digest in manifest['files'].items():
            path=root/name
            if Path(name).name!=name or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size>64*1024*1024:
                return False
            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:
                return False
        records=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'records.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
        if not 1<=len(records)<=1000:
            return False
        tasks=[];index=SemanticIndex()
        for row in records:
            task=TaskSpec.from_data(row['task']);tasks.append(task)
            if (row['schema_version']!=2 or row['generator_version']!='inverse-v2' or row['synthetic'] is not True
                    or task.content_id!=row['task_id'] or semantic_fingerprint(task)!=row['semantic_id'] or not index.add(task)):
                return False
            regenerated=generate_task(task.family,row['seed'],task.size)
            if regenerated.task!=task or row['witness_trace']!=build_trace(task,regenerated.witness).to_data():
                return False
            trace=VerificationTrace.from_data(row['solution_trace'])
            if not trace.to_data()['verification']['valid'] or trace.to_data()['task_id']!=task.content_id:
                return False
        card=json.loads((root/'card.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        expected=[];generation_index=SemanticIndex()
        for family,seed,size in sampling_plan(card['count'],card['seed'],card['families_requested'],card['sizes_requested']):
            item=generate_task(family,seed,size)
            if generation_index.add(item.task):
                expected.append((item.task.content_id,seed))
        if expected!=[(r['task_id'],r['seed']) for r in records]:
            return False
        if any(card.get(k)!=v for k,v in generation_index.report().items()):
            return False
        policy_data=dict(card['split_policy']);group=policy_data.pop('group')
        if group!='constructor_family':
            return False
        policy=SplitPolicy(**policy_data);assignments=assign_splits(tasks,policy)
        partitions={name:[json.loads(line) for line in (root/f'{name}.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
                    for name in ('train','validation','test')}
        expected_partitions={name:[r for r in records if r['split']==name] for name in partitions}
        if partitions!=expected_partitions or any(r['split']!=assignments[r['task_id']] for r in records):
            return False
        audit=audit_splits({k:[TaskSpec.from_data(r['task']) for r in rows] for k,rows in partitions.items()})
        if card['contamination']!=audit or not audit['clean'] or card['splits']!={k:len(v) for k,v in partitions.items()}:
            return False
        if not card['license_id'].strip() or not card['provenance'].strip() or any(r['license_id']!=card['license_id'] or r['provenance']!=card['provenance'] for r in records):
            return False
        profile=None
        if card['calibration_id'] is not None:
            profile=json.loads((root/'calibration.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            if profile['calibration_id']!=card['calibration_id'] or not validate_calibration(profile,tasks):
                return False
        for row in records:
            if row['calibration_id']!=card['calibration_id'] or row['difficulty']!=(profile['ratings'][row['task_id']] if profile else {'label':'uncalibrated'}):
                return False
        return True
    except (ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,OSError,ArithmeticError):
        return False

"""One reproducible local cycle: inverse construction -> independent solve -> checked artifacts."""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import tempfile

from ..core.semantic_ir import PolynomialSpec, ScientificTask, canonical_json
from ..expression import Binary, Number, Symbol
from ..documents.document_model import Equation, Figure
from ..dataset.scientific import audit_contamination, make_record, validate_record
from ..dataset.alignments import validate_alignment
from ..documents import Document, Section, to_html, to_latex, to_typst
from ..graphics import task_scene, render_svg
from ..graphics.raster_renderer import render_png
from ..verify import solve, verify
from .reverse_builder import generate


def run_cycle(destination: Path, *, count: int, seed: int, license_id: str,
              provenance: str, size: int = 3, pdf_backend: str | None = None) -> dict:
    if type(count) is not int or not 1 <= count <= 1000:
        raise ValueError('Quantidade deve estar entre 1 e 1000')
    if type(seed) is not int or not 0 <= seed <= 2**63 - 1 - count:
        raise ValueError('Semente fora do limite')
    if not license_id.strip() or not provenance.strip():
        raise ValueError('Licenca e procedencia obrigatorias')
    destination = Path(destination).absolute()
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.nabla-cycle-', dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        records = []
        seen = set()
        partitions = {name: [] for name in ('train', 'validation', 'test')}
        sections = []
        (stage / 'figures').mkdir()
        for i in range(count):
            family = ('polynomial_integral', 'linear_system')[i % 2]
            generated = generate(family, seed + i, size)
            task = generated.task
            solution = solve(task)
            if not verify(task, generated.witness).valid or not verify(task, solution).valid:
                raise ArithmeticError('Construtor e solver divergem na verificacao independente')
            if task.content_id in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(task.content_id)
            record = make_record(task, solution, license_id=license_id, provenance=provenance, seed=seed+i)
            records.append(record)
            partitions[record['split']].append(record)
            scene = task_scene(task, solution)
            prefix = stage / 'figures' / task.content_id
            prefix.with_suffix('.svg').write_text(render_svg(scene), encoding='utf-8')
            prefix.with_suffix('.png').write_bytes(render_png(scene))
            prefix.with_suffix('.json').write_text(canonical_json(scene.to_data()) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
            if family == 'polynomial_integral':
                equations = (Equation(Symbol('integrand'), PolynomialSpec(task.coefficients).to_expr()),
                             Equation(Symbol('primitive'), PolynomialSpec(solution).to_expr()))
                explanation = 'Primitiva escolhida com constante zero. Outras primitivas diferem por constante.'
            else:
                equations_list = []
                for row, target in zip(task.matrix, task.rhs):
                    lhs = Number(0)
                    for j, coefficient in enumerate(row):
                        lhs = Binary('+', lhs, Binary('*', Number(coefficient), Symbol(f'x{j+1}')))
                    equations_list.append(Equation(lhs, Number(target)))
                equations = tuple(equations_list)
                explanation = 'Solucao unica: ' + ', '.join(f'x{j+1}={v}' for j, v in enumerate(solution))
            sections.append(Section(family, explanation + ' Verificacao: ' + record['verification']['method'] + '.',
                (task.content_id,), equations,
                (Figure(f'figures/{task.content_id}.png', scene.label),)))
        audit = audit_contamination(partitions)
        document = Document('Nabla: ciclo cientifico sintetico', tuple(sections))
        for suffix, exporter in [('html', to_html), ('tex', to_latex), ('typ', to_typst)]:
            (stage / f'report.{suffix}').write_text(exporter(document), encoding='utf-8')
        if pdf_backend is not None:
            from ..documents.pdf_builder import build_pdf
            build_pdf(document, stage / 'report.pdf', pdf_backend, asset_root=stage)
        (stage / 'records.jsonl').write_text(''.join(canonical_json(r) + '\n' for r in records), encoding='utf-8')
        for split, subset in partitions.items():
            (stage / f'{split}.jsonl').write_text(''.join(canonical_json(r) + '\n' for r in subset), encoding='utf-8')
        summary = {'schema_version': 1, 'attempted': count, 'accepted': len(records),
                   'duplicates': count-len(records), 'seed': seed, 'size': size,
                   'license_id': license_id, 'provenance': provenance,
                   'families': dict(Counter(r['task']['family'] for r in records)),
                   'splits': {k: len(v) for k, v in partitions.items()}, 'contamination': audit,
                   'difficulty': 'uncalibrated', 'formal_proofs': 0,
                   'limitations': 'Duas familias sinteticas; sem avaliacao externa, utilidade de treino ou maturidade de fase demonstradas.'}
        (stage / 'card.json').write_text(canonical_json(summary) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        manifest = {'schema_version': 1, 'files': {p.relative_to(stage).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    for p in sorted(stage.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}}
        (stage / 'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
        if not verify_bundle(stage):
            raise ArithmeticError('Bundle falhou na revalidacao')
        if destination.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(destination)
        stage.rename(destination)
        return summary
    finally:
        if stage.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify_bundle(directory: Path) -> bool:
    """Hashes detect corruption; independent reexecution checks the scientific records."""
    try:
        root = Path(directory)
        manifest_path = root / 'manifest.json'
        if manifest_path.is_symlink() or manifest_path.stat().st_size > 1024*1024:
            return False
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if manifest['schema_version'] != 1 or not isinstance(manifest['files'], dict):
            return False
        actual_files = {p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p != manifest_path}
        if set(manifest['files']) != actual_files:
            return False
        for name, digest in manifest['files'].items():
            path = root / name
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()) or path.stat().st_size > 64*1024*1024:
                return False
            if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest:
                return False
        records = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / 'records.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
        if not records or len(records) > 1000 or not all(validate_record(r) for r in records):
            return False
        if len({r['task_id'] for r in records}) != len(records):
            return False
        if not all(validate_alignment(record, root) for record in records):
            return False
        partitions = {name: [json.loads(line) for line in (root / f'{name}.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
                      for name in ('train', 'validation', 'test')}
        if not audit_contamination(partitions)['clean']:
            return False
        card = json.loads((root / 'card.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        attempted, seed, size = card['attempted'], card['seed'], card['size']
        if type(attempted) is not int or not 1 <= attempted <= 1000:
            return False
        if type(seed) is not int or not 0 <= seed <= 2**63 - 1 - attempted:
            return False
        expected_tasks, seen = [], set()
        for i in range(attempted):
            family = ('polynomial_integral', 'linear_system')[i % 2]
            generated = generate(family, seed + i, size)
            if generated.task.content_id not in seen:
                expected_tasks.append((generated.task.content_id, seed+i))
                seen.add(generated.task.content_id)
        if [(r['task_id'], r['generator']['seed']) for r in records] != expected_tasks:
            return False
        if (card['schema_version'] != 1 or card['accepted'] != len(records)
                or card['duplicates'] != attempted-len(records) or card['formal_proofs'] != 0
                or card['difficulty'] != 'uncalibrated'
                or card['families'] != dict(Counter(r['task']['family'] for r in records))
                or card['splits'] != {k: len(v) for k, v in partitions.items()}
                or card['contamination'] != audit_contamination(partitions)
                or any(r['license_id'] != card['license_id'] or r['provenance'] != card['provenance'] for r in records)):
            return False
        expected = {name: [r for r in records if r['split'] == name] for name in partitions}
        return partitions == expected
    except (OSError, KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, ArithmeticError):
        return False

"""Versioned inverse construction; old generate() keeps its exact v1 contract."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from fractions import Fraction
from importlib import import_module
from ..core.semantic_ir import ScientificTask,canonical_json
from .task_spec import GeneratedProblem
from .sampling import rng_for

CONSTRUCTORS={'polynomial_integral':'integration','factored_polynomial':'polynomial',
              'linear_system':'linear_systems','prescribed_spectrum':'spectrum',
              'convex_quadratic':'optimization','stationary_markov':'markov',
              'polynomial_identity':'identities','counterexample':'counterexamples'}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GeneratedTask:
    task: ScientificTask
    witness: tuple[Fraction,...]
    seed: int
    generator_version: str='inverse-v1'


def generate_task(family,seed,size=3):
    rng_for(seed,size)
    if family not in CONSTRUCTORS:
        raise ValueError('Familia nao suportada')
    module=import_module(f'.constructors.{CONSTRUCTORS[family]}',__package__)
    task,witness=module.construct(seed,size)
    return GeneratedProblem(task,canonical_json(witness),seed)


def generate(family,seed,size=3):
    if family not in {'polynomial_integral','linear_system'}:
        raise ValueError('Use generate_task para as novas familias v2')
    generated=generate_task(family,seed,size)
    key='coefficients' if family=='polynomial_integral' else 'solution'
    return GeneratedTask(generated.task.legacy(),tuple(Fraction(v) for v in generated.witness[key]),seed)

"""Deterministic independent streams and bounded balanced sampling plans."""
import random
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint


def rng_for(seed,size=3):
    if type(seed) is not int or not 0<=seed<2**63 or type(size) is not int or not 1<=size<=8:
        raise ValueError('Semente de 63 bits e tamanho de 1 a 8 requeridos')
    return random.Random(seed)


def sampling_plan(count,seed,families,sizes=(2,3,4)):
    from .task_spec import FAMILIES
    rng_for(seed)
    if type(count) is not int or not 1<=count<=1000 or not families or len(set(families))!=len(families) or any(f not in FAMILIES for f in families):
        raise ValueError('Plano de familias ou quantidade invalido')
    if not sizes or len(set(sizes))!=len(sizes) or any(type(s) is not int or not 1<=s<=8 for s in sizes):
        raise ValueError('Tamanhos invalidos')
    for index in range(count):
        family=families[index%len(families)]
        size=sizes[(index//len(families))%len(sizes)]
        derived=int(fingerprint({'seed':seed,'index':index,'family':family,'size':size})[:15],16)
        yield family,derived,size

"""Two bounded strategies per family; neither receives constructor witnesses."""
from fractions import Fraction
from itertools import product
from ..core.semantic_ir import PolynomialSpec,rational
from ..expression import to_data,evaluate,render
from ..schema.expression import from_data
from ..math.linear_algebra import Matrix,solve_linear,characteristic_polynomial
from ..math.polynomials.univariate import Polynomial
from ..math.polynomials.factorization import factor_rational


def _linear(matrix,rhs,strategy):
    matrix=Matrix(tuple(tuple(rational(v) for v in row) for row in matrix))
    rhs=tuple(rational(v) for v in rhs)
    if strategy=='alternate':
        return tuple(row[0] for row in (matrix.inverse()@Matrix(tuple((v,) for v in rhs))).rows)
    result=solve_linear(matrix,rhs)
    if result.status!='unique':
        raise ValueError('Solver requer solucao unica')
    return result.particular


def _factor(coefficients,strategy):
    polynomial=Polynomial(tuple(rational(v) for v in coefficients))
    if strategy=='exact':
        result=factor_rational(polynomial)
        if not result.complete:
            raise ValueError('Fatores racionais incompletos')
        return result.roots
    roots=[]
    for root in range(-5,6):
        while polynomial.degree>0 and polynomial(root)==0:
            polynomial,remainder=polynomial.divmod(Polynomial((-root,1)))
            roots.append(Fraction(root))
    if polynomial.degree>0:
        raise ValueError('Estrategia de grade limitada a raizes inteiras -5..5')
    return tuple(roots)


def solve_task(task,strategy='exact'):
    if strategy not in {'exact','alternate'}:
        raise ValueError('Estrategia desconhecida')
    p=task.problem;n=task.size
    if task.family=='polynomial_integral':
        if strategy=='exact':
            from ..verify.certificate import solve
            coefficients=solve(task.legacy())
        else:
            coefficients=(Fraction(),)+tuple(rational(v)/(i+1) for i,v in enumerate(p['coefficients']))
        return {'coefficients':[str(v) for v in coefficients]}
    if task.family=='linear_system':
        return {'solution':[str(v) for v in _linear(p['matrix'],p['rhs'],strategy)]}
    if task.family=='factored_polynomial':
        return {'roots':[str(v) for v in _factor(p['coefficients'],strategy)]}
    if task.family=='convex_quadratic':
        return {'solution':[str(v) for v in _linear(p['matrix'],[-rational(v) for v in p['linear']],strategy)]}
    if task.family=='stationary_markov':
        rows=[[rational(p['transition'][j][i])-int(i==j) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
        rows[-1]=[Fraction(1)]*n
        rhs=[Fraction()]*(n-1)+[Fraction(1)]
        return {'stationary':[str(v) for v in _linear(rows,rhs,strategy)]}
    if task.family=='prescribed_spectrum':
        a=Matrix(tuple(tuple(rational(v) for v in row) for row in p['matrix']))
        if strategy=='exact':
            coefficients=characteristic_polynomial(a)
        else:
            # Independent determinant interpolation, not the trace recurrence.
            samples=[]
            for x in range(n+1):
                shifted=Matrix(tuple(tuple(Fraction(x)*int(i==j)-a.rows[i][j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)))
                samples.append(shifted.determinant())
            vandermonde=[[Fraction(x)**j for j in range(n+1)] for x in range(n+1)]
            coefficients=_linear(vandermonde,samples,'alternate')
        eigenvalues=_factor(coefficients,strategy)
        columns=[];ordered=[]
        for eigenvalue in sorted(set(eigenvalues)):
            shifted=Matrix(tuple(tuple(a.rows[i][j]-eigenvalue*int(i==j) for j in range(n)) for i in range(n)))
            basis=solve_linear(shifted,[Fraction()]*n).nullspace
            for vector in basis:
                columns.append(vector);ordered.append(eigenvalue)
        if len(columns)!=n:
            raise ValueError('Matriz nao diagonalizavel sobre racionais')
        return {'eigenvalues':[str(v) for v in ordered],
                'eigenvectors':[[str(columns[j][i]) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]}
    if task.family=='polynomial_identity':
        left=from_data(p['left'])
        if strategy=='exact':
            from ..math.algebra.groebner import polynomial_from_expr
            expression=polynomial_from_expr(left,tuple(p['variables'])).to_expr()
        else:
            # Polynomial identity reconstruction from degree+1 exact samples.
            from ..math.algebra.groebner import polynomial_from_expr
            if p['variables']!=['x']:
                raise ValueError('Interpolacao alternativa univariada')
            polynomial=polynomial_from_expr(left,('x',))
            degree=max((m[0] for m,_ in polynomial.terms),default=0)
            vandermonde=[[Fraction(x)**j for j in range(degree+1)] for x in range(degree+1)]
            samples=[evaluate(left,{'x':Fraction(x)}) for x in range(degree+1)]
            coefficients=_linear(vandermonde,samples,'alternate')
            expression=PolynomialSpec(tuple(coefficients)).to_expr()
        return {'expression':to_data(expression)}
    if task.family=='counterexample':
        left,right=from_data(p['left']),from_data(p['right'])
        if strategy=='exact':
            from ..falsifier import search_equivalence
            result=search_equivalence(render(left),render(right),radius=p['radius'],budget=100000)
            if result.status!='counterexample':
                raise ValueError('Sem contraexemplo no orcamento')
            return {'assignment':{name:str(value) for name,value in result.witness}}
        for values in product(range(p['radius'],-p['radius']-1,-1),repeat=len(p['variables'])):
            mapping={name:Fraction(value) for name,value in zip(p['variables'],values)}
            if evaluate(left,mapping)!=evaluate(right,mapping):
                return {'assignment':{name:str(v) for name,v in mapping.items()}}
        raise ValueError('Sem contraexemplo no dominio')
    raise ValueError('Familia nao suportada')
END FILE: src/nablamath/forge/solvers.py

"""Immutable problems for all eight inverse families; witnesses never enter task IDs."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
from ..core.semantic_ir import ScientificTask,PolynomialSpec,canonical_json,fingerprint,rational,SemanticExpression
from ..schema.expression import from_data

FAMILIES=('polynomial_integral','factored_polynomial','linear_system','prescribed_spectrum',
          'convex_quadratic','stationary_markov','polynomial_identity','counterexample')
FIELDS={'polynomial_integral':{'coefficients'},'factored_polynomial':{'coefficients'},
        'linear_system':{'matrix','rhs'},'prescribed_spectrum':{'matrix'},
        'convex_quadratic':{'matrix','linear','constant'},'stationary_markov':{'transition'},
        'polynomial_identity':{'left','right','variables'},'counterexample':{'left','right','variables','radius'}}


@dataclass(frozen=True,init=False)
class TaskSpec:
    family: str
    problem_json: str
    size: int
    schema_version: int=1

    def __init__(self,family,problem,size=3,schema_version=1):
        if family not in FAMILIES or type(size) is not int or not 1<=size<=8 or type(schema_version) is not int or schema_version!=1:
            raise ValueError('Familia, tamanho ou versao invalida')
        if not isinstance(problem,dict) or set(problem)!=FIELDS[family]:
            raise ValueError('Campos do problema invalidos')
        serialized=canonical_json(problem)
        if len(serialized)>32000:
            raise ValueError('Problema excede 32 KB')
        data=json.loads(serialized)
        def vector(values,n):
            if not isinstance(values,list) or len(values)!=n:
                raise ValueError('Dimensao de vetor invalida')
            return [str(rational(v)) for v in values]
        def matrix(rows):
            if not isinstance(rows,list) or len(rows)!=size:
                raise ValueError('Dimensao de matriz invalida')
            return [vector(row,size) for row in rows]
        if family in {'polynomial_integral','factored_polynomial'}:
            expected=size if family=='polynomial_integral' else size+1
            values=vector(data['coefficients'],expected)
            coefficients=PolynomialSpec(tuple(values))
            if len(coefficients.coefficients)!=expected:
                raise ValueError('Grau declarado diverge dos coeficientes')
            data['coefficients']=coefficients.to_data()
        if 'matrix' in data:
            data['matrix']=matrix(data['matrix'])
        if family=='linear_system':
            data['rhs']=vector(data['rhs'],size)
        if family=='convex_quadratic':
            data['linear']=vector(data['linear'],size)
            data['constant']=str(rational(data['constant']))
        if family=='stationary_markov':
            data['transition']=matrix(data['transition'])
            rows=[[rational(v) for v in row] for row in data['transition']]
            if any(any(v<0 for v in row) or sum(row)!=1 for row in rows):
                raise ValueError('Transicao nao estocastica')
        if family in {'polynomial_identity','counterexample'}:
            variables=data['variables']
            if not isinstance(variables,list) or not 1<=len(variables)<=3 or len(set(variables))!=len(variables):
                raise ValueError('Variaveis invalidas')
            from ..expression import Symbol
            from ..math.algebra.groebner import polynomial_from_expr
            for v in variables:
                Symbol(v)
            for side in ('left','right'):
                expr=from_data(data[side])
                SemanticExpression(expr)
                polynomial=polynomial_from_expr(expr,tuple(variables))
                if any(sum(m)>16 for m,_ in polynomial.terms) or len(polynomial.terms)>128:
                    raise ValueError('Identidade excede limites polinomiais')
            data['variables']=sorted(variables)
            if family=='counterexample' and (type(data['radius']) is not int or not 1<=data['radius']<=16):
                raise ValueError('Dominio do contraexemplo invalido')
        object.__setattr__(self,'family',family)
        object.__setattr__(self,'problem_json',canonical_json(data))
        object.__setattr__(self,'size',size)
        object.__setattr__(self,'schema_version',1)

    @property
    def problem(self):
        return json.loads(self.problem_json)

    def to_data(self):
        return {'schema_version':1,'family':self.family,'size':self.size,'domain':'rational','problem':self.problem}

    @property
    def content_id(self):
        return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    @property
    def family_key(self):
        return f'{self.family}:size={self.size}'

    def legacy(self):
        if self.family=='polynomial_integral':
            return ScientificTask(self.family,coefficients=tuple(self.problem['coefficients']))
        if self.family=='linear_system':
            p=self.problem
            return ScientificTask(self.family,matrix=tuple(tuple(r) for r in p['matrix']),rhs=tuple(p['rhs']))
        raise ValueError('Familia sem contrato legado')

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'schema_version','family','size','domain','problem'} or data['domain']!='rational':
            raise ValueError('Contrato Forge invalido')
        return cls(data['family'],data['problem'],data['size'],data['schema_version'])


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GeneratedProblem:
    task: TaskSpec
    witness_json: str
    seed: int
    generator_version: str='inverse-v2'

    @property
    def witness(self):
        return json.loads(self.witness_json)

"""Portable question–statement–certificate bundles with pinned toolchain metadata."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
from ..core.semantic_ir import canonical_json
from .statement import FormalStatement
from .translation_review import verify_translation_binding
from ..verify.certificate import verify_formal_certificate


def export_formal_bundle(question,statement,certificate,binding,destination,*,project=Path('lean')):
    project=Path(project)
    if not verify_translation_binding(binding,question=question,statement=statement,task_id=binding['task_id']):
        raise ValueError('Vínculo pergunta/enunciado inválido')
    if certificate['statement']!=statement.to_data() or not verify_formal_certificate(certificate,project=project):
        raise ValueError('Certificado não reproduzível para o enunciado')
    destination=Path(destination)
    if destination.exists():raise FileExistsError(destination)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    stage=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.formal-',dir=destination.parent))
    try:
        for name,data in (('question.json',{'question':question}),('statement.json',statement.to_data()),
                          ('certificate.json',certificate),('binding.json',binding)):
            (stage/name).write_text(canonical_json(data)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        pinned={}
        for name in ('lean-toolchain','lakefile.toml','lake-manifest.json'):
            path=project/name
            if path.is_file():
                content=path.read_bytes()
                if len(content)>2*1024*1024:raise ValueError('Lockfile excede limite')
                (stage/name).write_bytes(content);pinned[name]=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        if certificate['backend_receipt']['backend']=='lean4':
            from .lean_bridge import translate_statement
            translation=translate_statement(statement,certificate['backend_receipt']['strategy'])
            (stage/'proof.lean').write_text(translation.source,encoding='utf-8')
        manifest={'schema_version':1,'statement_id':statement.content_id,'certificate_id':certificate['certificate_id'],
                  'toolchain_files':pinned,'files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in stage.iterdir()},
                  'review_accepted':binding['accepted'],'reviewer_identity_authenticated':False,
                  'scope':'Backend-rechecked certificate and declared translation review; install pinned dependencies to reproduce.'}
        (stage/'manifest.json').write_text(canonical_json(manifest)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
        if not verify_formal_bundle(stage,project=project):raise ValueError('Bundle formal não reproduzível')
        stage.rename(destination)
        return manifest
    finally:
        if stage.exists():shutil.rmtree(stage)


def verify_formal_bundle(root,*,project=Path('lean')):
    try:
        root=Path(root);project=Path(project)
        if (root/'manifest.json').stat().st_size>1024*1024:return False
        manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        files={p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.name!='manifest.json'}
        if manifest['schema_version']!=1 or files!=set(manifest['files']):return False
        allowed={'question.json','statement.json','certificate.json','binding.json','proof.lean','lean-toolchain','lakefile.toml','lake-manifest.json'}
        if not files<=allowed or not {'question.json','statement.json','certificate.json','binding.json'}<=files:return False
        for name,digest in manifest['files'].items():
            path=root/name
            if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size>4*1024*1024 or hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:return False
        for name,digest in manifest['toolchain_files'].items():
            if name not in ('lean-toolchain','lakefile.toml','lake-manifest.json') or hashlib.sha256((project/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=digest:return False
        def read(name):return json.loads((root/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        statement=FormalStatement.from_data(read('statement.json'));certificate=read('certificate.json');binding=read('binding.json')
        if not verify_translation_binding(binding,question=read('question.json')['question'],statement=statement,task_id=binding['task_id']):return False
        if (statement.content_id!=manifest['statement_id'] or certificate['certificate_id']!=manifest['certificate_id']
                or certificate['statement']!=statement.to_data() or manifest['review_accepted']!=binding['accepted']
                or manifest['reviewer_identity_authenticated'] is not False):return False
        if certificate['backend_receipt']['backend']=='lean4':
            from .lean_bridge import translate_statement
            if (root/'proof.lean').read_text(encoding='utf-8')!=translate_statement(statement,certificate['backend_receipt']['strategy']).source:return False
        return verify_formal_certificate(certificate,project=project)
    except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,OSError):return False

"""Isolated Lean execution with timeouts and diagnostics."""
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import os
import tempfile
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..research import ResearchResult
from ..symbolic.patterns import RewriteRule
from .translate import lean_source, rule_lean_source

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FormalCheck:
    verified: bool
    detail: str
    content_id: str

def _verify_source(source_text: str, content_id: str, project: Path, timeout_s: int, success_detail: str) -> FormalCheck:
    project=project.resolve()
    if not (project/"lakefile.toml").is_file(): raise ValueError("Projeto Lean não encontrado")
    if not 1<=timeout_s<=900: raise ValueError("timeout fora do intervalo")
    from .lean_checker import find_lake
    lake=find_lake(project)
    if lake is None: return FormalCheck(False,"lake não encontrado",content_id)
    environment=dict(os.environ)
    environment['PATH']=str(lake.parent)+os.pathsep+environment.get('PATH','')
    if any(token in source_text for token in ('sorry', 'admit', 'axiom ')):
        return FormalCheck(False,"Fonte com admissao ou axioma rejeitada",content_id)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nablamath-lean-") as directory:
        source=Path(directory)/"Check.lean"; source.write_text(source_text,encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            process=subprocess.run([str(lake),"env","lean",str(source)],cwd=project,env=environment,capture_output=True,text=True,
                                   timeout=timeout_s,check=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return FormalCheck(False,"lake não encontrado",content_id)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return FormalCheck(False,"timeout",content_id)
    if "sorry" in process.stdout+process.stderr: return FormalCheck(False,"Admissao Lean rejeitada",content_id)
    if process.returncode: return FormalCheck(False,(process.stderr or process.stdout)[-2000:],content_id)
    return FormalCheck(True,success_detail,content_id)

def verify_with_lean(result: "ResearchResult", project: Path, timeout_s: int=120) -> FormalCheck:
    return _verify_source(lean_source(result),result.content_id,project,timeout_s,"Lean verificou a instância racional")

def verify_rule_with_lean(rule: RewriteRule, project: Path, timeout_s: int=120) -> FormalCheck:
    return _verify_source(rule_lean_source(rule),rule.rule_hash,project,timeout_s,"Lean verificou a regra universal")

__all__=["FormalCheck","verify_with_lean","verify_rule_with_lean"]

"""AST-only Lean translation; no user proof snippets, unchecked axioms or source injection."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from .statement import FormalStatement,RELATIONS
from .translate import lean_term

STRATEGIES=('auto','ring','field','linarith','nlinarith','norm_num')


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LeanTranslation:
    statement: FormalStatement
    source: str
    strategy: str='auto'

    @property
    def source_hash(self):
        return fingerprint({'source':self.source})

    def to_data(self):
        return {'backend':'lean4','statement':self.statement.to_data(),'statement_id':self.statement.content_id,
                'strategy':self.strategy,'source':self.source,'source_hash':self.source_hash,
                'bindings':{name:'nabla_'+name for name in self.statement.variables},
                'hypotheses':[p.to_data() for p in self.statement.hypotheses]}


def translate_statement(statement: FormalStatement,strategy='auto'):
    if strategy not in STRATEGIES:
        raise ValueError('Estrategia Lean nao permitida')
    def predicate(p):
        return f'{lean_term(p.left)} {RELATIONS[p.relation]} {lean_term(p.right)}'
    variables=' '.join(f'(nabla_{name} : ℚ)' for name in statement.variables)
    hypotheses=' '.join(f'(h{i} : {predicate(p)})' for i,p in enumerate(statement.hypotheses))
    names=', '.join(f'h{i}' for i in range(len(statement.hypotheses)))
    field=f'field_simp [{names}] <;> ring' if names else 'field_simp <;> ring'
    strategies={'ring':'ring','field':field,'linarith':'linarith','nlinarith':'nlinarith','norm_num':'norm_num',
                'auto':f'first | (solve | norm_num) | (solve | ring) | (solve | {field}) | (solve | linarith)'}
    source=('import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum\n\nset_option autoImplicit false\nset_option maxHeartbeats 200000\n'
            +f'-- AST statement sha256: {statement.content_id}\n'
            +f'theorem nabla_generated {variables} {hypotheses} : {predicate(statement.goal)} := by\n'
            +f'  {strategies[strategy]}\n\n#print axioms nabla_generated\n')
    return LeanTranslation(statement,source,strategy)

"""Compile generated Lean and reject admissions, unmatched translations and nonstandard axioms."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile

from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from .lean_bridge import translate_statement
from .translation_review import review_translation

ALLOWED_AXIOMS={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}


def run_lean_process(command,*,cwd,env,timeout):
    """An isolated process group ensures a timeout also stops Lean spawned by Lake."""
    with subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                          text=True,start_new_session=os.name!='nt') as process:
        try:
            stdout,stderr=process.communicate(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            if os.name!='nt':
                try:os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:pass
            else:process.kill()
            process.communicate()
            raise
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command,process.returncode,stdout,stderr)


def find_lake(project):
    executable=shutil.which('lake')
    if executable:
        return Path(executable)
    project=Path(project).resolve()
    pin=(project/'lean-toolchain').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() if (project/'lean-toolchain').is_file() else ''
    match=re.fullmatch(r'leanprover/lean4:v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)',pin)
    if match:
        candidate=project.parent.parent/'.tools'/'lean'/f'lean-{match[1]}-linux'/'bin'/'lake'
        if candidate.is_file():
            return candidate
    return None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LeanCheck:
    status: str
    statement_id: str
    source_hash: str
    tool_version: str | None
    axioms: tuple[str,...]
    diagnostics: str
    review: dict
    returncode: int | None=None
    strategy: str="auto"

    @property
    def verified(self):
        return self.status=='proved'

    def to_data(self):
        from dataclasses import asdict
        payload={**asdict(self),'backend':'lean4','formal_proof':self.verified}
        return {**payload,'receipt_id':fingerprint(payload)}


def check_lean(translation,project=Path('lean'),timeout=120):
    if type(timeout) is not int or not 1<=timeout<=300:
        raise ValueError('Timeout Lean deve estar entre 1 e 300 segundos')
    review=review_translation(translation)
    def result(status,detail,version=None,axioms=(),code=None):
        return LeanCheck(status,translation.statement.content_id,translation.source_hash,version,tuple(axioms),detail,review.to_data(),code,translation.strategy)
    if not review.accepted:
        return result('translation_rejected','; '.join(review.errors))
    project=Path(project).resolve()
    if not (project/'lean-toolchain').is_file() or not ((project/'lakefile.toml').is_file() or (project/'lakefile.lean').is_file()):
        return result('unavailable','Lean project missing')
    lake=find_lake(project)
    if lake is None:
        return result('unavailable','lake not installed')
    environment=dict(os.environ)
    environment['PATH']=str(lake.parent)+os.pathsep+environment.get('PATH','')
    try:
        version=run_lean_process([str(lake),'env','lean','--version'],cwd=project,env=environment,
                                 timeout=min(timeout,20))
        if version.returncode:
            return result('unavailable',(version.stdout+version.stderr)[-4000:])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='nabla-prove-') as directory:
            source=Path(directory)/'Check.lean'
            source.write_text(translation.source,encoding='utf-8')
            completed=run_lean_process([str(lake),'env','lean',str(source)],cwd=project,env=environment,timeout=timeout)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return result('unavailable','Lean runtime missing')
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return result('timeout','Lean timeout')
    output=completed.stdout+'\n'+completed.stderr
    matches=re.findall(r"depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]",output)
    no_axioms='does not depend on any axioms' in output
    axioms=tuple(sorted({name.strip() for group in matches for name in group.split(',') if name.strip()}))
    if completed.returncode:
        return result('failed',output[-6000:],version.stdout.strip(),axioms,completed.returncode)
    if 'sorry' in output or set(axioms)-ALLOWED_AXIOMS or (not matches and not no_axioms):
        return result('rejected_axioms',output[-6000:],version.stdout.strip(),axioms,completed.returncode)
    return result('proved',output[-6000:],version.stdout.strip(),axioms,completed.returncode)


def prove_statement(statement,project=Path('lean'),strategy='auto',timeout=120):
    return check_lean(translate_statement(statement,strategy),project,timeout)

"""Obrigações de prova persistíveis sem confundir proposta com prova."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum


class ObligationStatus(str, Enum):
    OPEN = "open"
    VERIFIED = "verified"
    REJECTED = "rejected"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Obligation:
    identifier: str
    statement: str
    status: ObligationStatus = ObligationStatus.OPEN
    reason: str = ""

    def close(self, status: ObligationStatus, reason: str) -> "Obligation":
        if status is ObligationStatus.OPEN or not reason.strip():
            raise ValueError("Fechamento exige estado final e razão")
        return Obligation(self.identifier, self.statement, status, reason)


__all__ = ["Obligation", "ObligationStatus"]

"""Deterministic Lean proof search over a closed, auditable tactic portfolio.

This is the repair-loop foundation: NablaMath generates a typed theorem from its
own AST, tries only named strategies from an allow-list, records every rejection,
and returns the first source accepted by the Lean kernel. It never evaluates
user-supplied tactic text.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

from ..expression import Binary, Expr, Symbol
from ..symbolic.patterns import RewriteRule, instantiate_expr, pattern_variables
from .check import _verify_source
from .translate import universal_lean_source


TACTIC_PORTFOLIO: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("ring", "  ring\n"),
    ("ring_nf", "  ring_nf\n"),
    ("field_ring", "  field_simp <;> ring\n"),
    ("norm_num", "  norm_num\n"),
    ("linarith", "  linarith\n"),
    ("nlinarith", "  nlinarith\n"),
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProofAttempt:
    strategy: str
    verified: bool
    detail: str
    source_hash: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProofSearchResult:
    verified: bool
    theorem_name: str
    source: str | None
    strategy: str | None
    attempts: tuple[ProofAttempt, ...]

    @property
    def content_id(self) -> str:
        payload = "|".join(f"{a.strategy}:{a.source_hash}:{int(a.verified)}" for a in self.attempts)
        return hashlib.sha256((self.theorem_name + "|" + payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _contains_division(expr: Expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(expr, Binary):
        return expr.op == "/" or _contains_division(expr.left) or _contains_division(expr.right)
    return False


def candidate_strategies(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, nonzero: Iterable[Expr] = ()) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Return a deterministic tactic ordering based only on typed AST features."""
    has_denominator = _contains_division(lhs) or _contains_division(rhs)
    has_hypotheses = bool(tuple(nonzero))
    preferred = ["field_ring", "ring", "ring_nf"] if (has_denominator or has_hypotheses) else ["ring", "ring_nf"]
    preferred += ["norm_num", "linarith", "nlinarith"]
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(preferred))


def _source_for_strategy(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, *, nonzero: tuple[Expr, ...],
                         theorem_name: str, strategy: str) -> str:
    bodies = dict(TACTIC_PORTFOLIO)
    if strategy not in bodies:
        raise ValueError(f"Estratégia fora da carteira permitida: {strategy}")
    base = universal_lean_source(lhs, rhs, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=theorem_name)
    marker = ":= by\n"
    prefix, separator, _ = base.partition(marker)
    if not separator:
        raise RuntimeError("Gerador Lean não produziu corpo de prova reconhecível")
    body = bodies[strategy]
    if strategy == "field_ring" and nonzero:
        hypotheses = ", ".join(f"h{i}" for i in range(len(nonzero)))
        body = f"  field_simp [{hypotheses}] <;> ring\n"
    return prefix + marker + body


def search_universal_proof(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, project: Path, *,
                           nonzero: Iterable[Expr] = (), theorem_name: str = "nablamath_search",
                           timeout_s: int = 60) -> ProofSearchResult:
    nonzero = tuple(nonzero)
    attempts: list[ProofAttempt] = []
    for strategy in candidate_strategies(lhs, rhs, nonzero):
        source = _source_for_strategy(lhs, rhs, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=theorem_name, strategy=strategy)
        source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        check = _verify_source(source, source_hash, project, timeout_s, f"Lean aceitou {strategy}")
        attempts.append(ProofAttempt(strategy, check.verified, check.detail, source_hash))
        if check.verified:
            return ProofSearchResult(True, theorem_name, source, strategy, tuple(attempts))
    return ProofSearchResult(False, theorem_name, None, None, tuple(attempts))


def search_rule_proof(rule: RewriteRule, project: Path, *, timeout_s: int = 60) -> ProofSearchResult:
    bindings = {name: Symbol(name) for name in pattern_variables(rule.lhs)}
    lhs = instantiate_expr(rule.lhs, bindings)
    rhs = instantiate_expr(rule.rhs, bindings)
    nonzero = tuple(bindings[c.variable] for c in rule.conditions if c.kind == "nonzero")
    safe_name = "nablamath_search_" + "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch == "_" else "_" for ch in rule.name)
    return search_universal_proof(lhs, rhs, project, nonzero=nonzero, theorem_name=safe_name, timeout_s=timeout_s)


def verify_ruleset_with_lean(
    rules: Iterable[RewriteRule], project: Path, *, timeout_s: int = 60
) -> tuple[tuple[str, ProofSearchResult], ...]:
    return tuple((rule.name, search_rule_proof(rule, project, timeout_s=timeout_s)) for rule in rules)


__all__ = [
    "TACTIC_PORTFOLIO", "ProofAttempt", "ProofSearchResult", "candidate_strategies",
    "search_universal_proof", "search_rule_proof", "verify_ruleset_with_lean",
]
END FILE: src/nablamath/formal/search.py

"""QF_LRA over rationals, with explicit hypotheses and independently replayed SAT models."""
from fractions import Fraction
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint,rational
from ..expression import Binary,Number,Symbol
from .statement import FormalStatement


def solve_statement(statement,*,timeout_ms=5000):
    if type(timeout_ms) is not int or not 1<=timeout_ms<=60000:
        raise ValueError('Timeout SMT deve estar entre 1 e 60000 ms')
    try:
        import z3
    except ImportError:
        return {'status':'unavailable','backend':'z3','formal_proof':False,'statement_id':statement.content_id}
    context=z3.Context(proof=True)
    variables={name:z3.Real('nabla_'+name,ctx=context) for name in statement.variables}
    def term(expr):
        if isinstance(expr,Number):
            return z3.RealVal(str(expr.value.numerator)+'/'+str(expr.value.denominator),ctx=context),True
        if isinstance(expr,Symbol):
            return variables[expr.name],False
        left,lc=term(expr.left);right,rc=term(expr.right)
        if expr.op=='+':return left+right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='-':return left-right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='*' and (lc or rc):return left*right,lc and rc
        if expr.op=='/' and rc:
            constant=z3.simplify(right)
            if not z3.is_rational_value(constant) or constant.numerator_as_long()==0:
                raise ValueError('zero_or_nonrational_constant_divisor')
            return left/right,lc
        if expr.op=='**' and isinstance(expr.right,Number) and expr.right.value in (0,1):
            return (z3.RealVal(1,ctx=context),True) if expr.right.value==0 else (left,lc)
        raise ValueError('outside_QF_LRA_fragment')
    def predicate(p):
        a,_=term(p.left);b,_=term(p.right)
        return {'eq':lambda:a==b,'ne':lambda:a!=b,'le':lambda:a<=b,'lt':lambda:a<b,'ge':lambda:a>=b,'gt':lambda:a>b}[p.relation]()
    base={'backend':'z3','logic':'QF_LRA','solver_version':z3.get_version_string(),
          'statement':statement.to_data(),'statement_id':statement.content_id,'formal_proof':False,
          'trust':'Z3 result; not a Lean kernel proof','timeout_ms':timeout_ms}
    try:
        assumptions=[predicate(p) for p in statement.hypotheses]
        goal=predicate(statement.goal)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return {**base,'status':'unsupported','reason':str(exc)}
    solver=z3.SolverFor('QF_LRA',ctx=context);solver.set(timeout=timeout_ms)
    solver.add(*assumptions)
    consistent=solver.check()
    if consistent==z3.unsat:
        return {**base,'status':'inconsistent_assumptions','reason':'vacuous theorem rejected','query':solver.sexpr()}
    if consistent==z3.unknown:
        return {**base,'status':'unknown','reason':solver.reason_unknown(),'query':solver.sexpr()}
    solver.add(z3.Not(goal))
    query=solver.sexpr();status=solver.check()
    result={**base,'query':query,'query_hash':fingerprint({'query':query})}
    if status==z3.unsat:
        proof=solver.proof().sexpr()
        result.update(status='unsat',proof=proof[:1000000],proof_truncated=len(proof)>1000000,
                      interpretation='goal holds for all rationals satisfying the explicit hypotheses')
    elif status==z3.sat:
        model=solver.model();witness={}
        for name,var in variables.items():
            value=model.eval(var,model_completion=True)
            if not z3.is_rational_value(value):
                return {**result,'status':'unknown','reason':'nonrational_model'}
            witness[name]=str(Fraction(value.numerator_as_long(),value.denominator_as_long()))
        exact={n:rational(v) for n,v in witness.items()}
        if not all(p.evaluate(exact) for p in statement.hypotheses) or statement.goal.evaluate(exact):
            return {**result,'status':'replay_failed','witness':witness}
        result.update(status='counterexample',witness=witness,exact_replay=True)
    else:
        result.update(status='unknown',reason=solver.reason_unknown())
    return {**result,'receipt_id':fingerprint(result)}

"""Restricted rational propositions with partial-expression domain obligations."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from ..core.semantic_ir import SemanticExpression,canonical_json,fingerprint,rational
from ..core.obligations import domain_obligations
from ..expression import Expr,Number,parse_expr,to_data,evaluate
from ..schema.expression import from_data
from .translate import free_symbols

RELATIONS={'eq':'=','ne':'≠','le':'≤','lt':'<','ge':'≥','gt':'>'}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Predicate:
    left: Expr
    relation: str
    right: Expr

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.relation not in RELATIONS:
            raise ValueError('Relacao formal invalida')
        SemanticExpression(self.left);SemanticExpression(self.right)

    def to_data(self):
        return {'left':to_data(self.left),'relation':self.relation,'right':to_data(self.right)}

    def evaluate(self,values):
        a,b=evaluate(self.left,values),evaluate(self.right,values)
        return {'eq':a==b,'ne':a!=b,'le':a<=b,'lt':a<b,'ge':a>=b,'gt':a>b}[self.relation]

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'left','relation','right'}:
            raise ValueError('Predicado serializado invalido')
        return cls(from_data(data['left']),data['relation'],from_data(data['right']))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FormalStatement:
    goal: Predicate
    assumptions: tuple[Predicate,...]=()

    def __post_init__(self):
        if len(self.assumptions)>32:
            raise ValueError('Maximo 32 hipoteses')
        object.__setattr__(self,'assumptions',tuple(self.assumptions))
        if len(self.variables)>8:
            raise ValueError('Maximo oito variaveis formais')

    @classmethod
    def equality(cls,left,right,assumptions=()):
        return cls(Predicate(parse_expr(left),'eq',parse_expr(right)),tuple(assumptions))

    @property
    def variables(self):
        names=set()
        for predicate in (self.goal,*self.assumptions):
            names.update(free_symbols(predicate.left));names.update(free_symbols(predicate.right))
        return tuple(sorted(names))

    @property
    def domain(self):
        obligations=[]
        for predicate in (self.goal,*self.assumptions):
            for side in (predicate.left,predicate.right):
                obligations.extend(domain_obligations(side))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(Predicate(o.expression,'ne',Number(rational(0))) for o in obligations))

    @property
    def hypotheses(self):
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*self.domain,*self.assumptions)))

    def to_data(self):
        return {'schema_version':1,'domain':'partial_rational','goal':self.goal.to_data(),
                'assumptions':[p.to_data() for p in self.assumptions],
                'domain_obligations':[p.to_data() for p in self.domain],'variables':list(self.variables)}

    @property
    def content_id(self):
        return fingerprint(self.to_data())

    @classmethod
    def from_data(cls,data):
        if not isinstance(data,dict) or set(data)!={'schema_version','domain','goal','assumptions','domain_obligations','variables'} or data['schema_version']!=1 or data['domain']!='partial_rational':
            raise ValueError('Contrato de enunciado invalido')
        result=cls(Predicate.from_data(data['goal']),tuple(Predicate.from_data(p) for p in data['assumptions']))
        if result.to_data()!=data:
            raise ValueError('Dominio ou variaveis divergentes')
        return result

"""Typed AST -> Lean translation without accepting arbitrary Lean source text."""
from __future__ import annotations
from fractions import Fraction
import re
from typing import Iterable, Mapping, TYPE_CHECKING
from ..expression import Binary, Expr, Number, Symbol
from ..symbolic.patterns import RewriteRule, instantiate_expr, pattern_variables
if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ..research import ResearchResult

_LEAN_THEOREM = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_']*\Z")

def _rational(value: Fraction) -> str:
    numerator=f"({value.numerator} : ℚ)"
    return numerator if value.denominator==1 else f"({numerator} / ({value.denominator} : ℚ))"

def _lean_name(name: str) -> str:
    Symbol(name)
    return f"nabla_{name}"

def _term(expr: Expr, values: Mapping[str, Fraction] | None) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Number): return _rational(expr.value)
    if isinstance(expr, Symbol):
        if values is None: return _lean_name(expr.name)
        if expr.name not in values: raise ValueError(f"Sem valor para símbolo {expr.name}")
        return _rational(values[expr.name])
    left,right=_term(expr.left,values),_term(expr.right,values)
    if expr.op=="**":
        exponent=expr.right.value.numerator if isinstance(expr.right,Number) and expr.right.value.denominator==1 else None
        if exponent is None: raise ValueError("Expoente Lean precisa ser literal inteiro")
        base=f"(({left}) ^ ({abs(exponent)} : ℕ))"
        return f"({base})⁻¹" if exponent<0 else base
    return f"({left} {expr.op} {right})"

def lean_term(expr: Expr) -> str: return _term(expr,None)

def free_symbols(expr: Expr) -> tuple[str,...]:
    names=set()
    def visit(node):
        if isinstance(node,Symbol): names.add(node.name)
        elif isinstance(node,Binary): visit(node.left); visit(node.right)
    visit(expr); return tuple(sorted(names))

def lean_source(result: "ResearchResult") -> str:
    values=dict(result.values)
    return ("import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum\n\n"
            f"-- Instância racional {result.content_id}; gerada de AST restrita.\n"
            f"example : {_term(result.original,values)} = {_rational(result.value)} := by\n"
            "  norm_num\n")

def universal_lean_source(lhs: Expr, rhs: Expr, *, nonzero: Iterable[Expr]=(),
                          theorem_name: str="nablamath_generated") -> str:
    if not _LEAN_THEOREM.fullmatch(theorem_name): raise ValueError("Nome de teorema Lean inválido")
    from ..core.obligations import domain_obligations
    nonzero=tuple(dict.fromkeys((*tuple(nonzero),
        *(o.expression for side in (lhs,rhs) for o in domain_obligations(side)))))
    names=set(free_symbols(lhs))|set(free_symbols(rhs))
    for expr in nonzero: names.update(free_symbols(expr))
    declarations=" ".join(f"({_lean_name(name)} : ℚ)" for name in sorted(names))
    hypotheses=" ".join(f"(h{i} : {lean_term(expr)} ≠ 0)" for i,expr in enumerate(nonzero))
    binders=" ".join(part for part in (declarations,hypotheses) if part)
    hs=", ".join(f"h{i}" for i in range(len(nonzero)))
    tactic=f"  field_simp [{hs}] <;> ring\n" if hs else "  field_simp <;> ring\n"
    return ("import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith\nimport Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum\n\n-- Teorema universal gerado de AST tipada pelo NablaMath.\n"
            f"theorem {theorem_name} {binders} : {lean_term(lhs)} = {lean_term(rhs)} := by\n"+tactic)

def rule_lean_source(rule: RewriteRule) -> str:
    bindings={name:Symbol(name) for name in pattern_variables(rule.lhs)}
    lhs=instantiate_expr(rule.lhs,bindings); rhs=instantiate_expr(rule.rhs,bindings)
    nonzero=tuple(bindings[c.variable] for c in rule.conditions if c.kind=="nonzero")
    safe_name="nablamath_rule_"+re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]","_",rule.name)
    source=universal_lean_source(lhs,rhs,nonzero=nonzero,theorem_name=safe_name)
    return source.replace("-- Teorema universal gerado de AST tipada pelo NablaMath.\n",
                          f"-- Regra {rule.name}; sha256={rule.rule_hash}\n",1)

__all__=["lean_source","lean_term","free_symbols","universal_lean_source","rule_lean_source"]

"""Machine structural review, independent from human scientific approval and proof status."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from ..core.semantic_ir import fingerprint
from .review import TranslationReview  # preserve the original explicit human-review record


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StructuralReview:
    accepted: bool
    statement_id: str
    source_hash: str
    checks: tuple[str,...]
    errors: tuple[str,...]=()
    human_reviewed: bool=False

    def to_data(self):
        from dataclasses import asdict
        return asdict(self)


def review_translation(translation):
    from .lean_bridge import translate_statement
    expected=translate_statement(translation.statement,translation.strategy)
    errors=[]
    if translation.source!=expected.source:
        errors.append('source_does_not_match_typed_statement')
    checks=('exact_ast_regeneration','variable_bijection','all_domain_obligations_explicit',
            'only_whitelisted_tactics','no_user_lean_source')
    return StructuralReview(not errors,translation.statement.content_id,translation.source_hash,checks,tuple(errors))


def bind_translation(question, statement, *, task_id, reviewer, notes, accepted):
    """Bind a declared human review to exact question/statement/domain versions.

    This is a tamper-evident review record, not identity authentication or a
    machine proof that natural language means the supplied formal statement.
    """
    from .statement import FormalStatement
    if (not isinstance(statement, FormalStatement) or type(accepted) is not bool
            or any(not isinstance(v, str) or not v.strip() for v in (question, task_id, reviewer, notes))
            or len(question) > 100000):
        raise ValueError('Pergunta, tarefa, formalização e revisão explícita obrigatórias')
    payload = {'schema_version': 1, 'question': question, 'question_id': fingerprint(question),
               'task_id': task_id, 'statement': statement.to_data(), 'statement_id': statement.content_id,
               'reviewer': reviewer, 'notes': notes, 'accepted': accepted,
               'reviewer_identity_authenticated': False, 'semantic_equivalence_machine_proved': False}
    return {**payload, 'binding_id': fingerprint(payload)}


def verify_translation_binding(binding, *, question, statement, task_id):
    try:
        expected = bind_translation(question, statement, task_id=task_id, reviewer=binding['reviewer'],
                                    notes=binding['notes'], accepted=binding['accepted'])
        return expected == binding
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return False

"""Deterministic batched Monte-Carlo tree search with explicit work budgets."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
import random
from typing import Callable, Generic, Hashable, Sequence, TypeVar

State = TypeVar("State", bound=Hashable)
Action = TypeVar("Action", bound=Hashable)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCTSConfig:
    simulations: int = 1_024
    max_depth: int = 64
    exploration: float = math.sqrt(2.0)
    batch_size: int = 64
    seed: int = 0

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.simulations < 1 or self.max_depth < 1 or self.batch_size < 1:
            raise ValueError("Orçamentos MCTS devem ser positivos")
        if not math.isfinite(self.exploration) or self.exploration < 0:
            raise ValueError("exploration deve ser finito e não negativo")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ActionStatistic(Generic[Action]):
    action: Action
    visits: int
    mean_value: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MCTSResult(Generic[Action]):
    action: Action | None
    simulations: int
    statistics: tuple[ActionStatistic[Action], ...]


@dataclass
class _Node(Generic[State, Action]):
    state: State
    parent: _Node[State, Action] | None
    action: Action | None
    unexpanded: list[Action]
    children: dict[Action, _Node[State, Action]]
    visits: int = 0
    value_sum: float = 0.0


def batch_mcts(
    initial: State,
    *,
    actions: Callable[[State], Sequence[Action]],
    transition: Callable[[State, Action], State],
    evaluate: Callable[[Sequence[State]], Sequence[float]],
    terminal: Callable[[State], bool],
    config: MCTSConfig = MCTSConfig(),
) -> MCTSResult[Action]:
    """Search with batched leaf evaluation, suitable for a neural device backend.

    ``evaluate`` receives a batch, making accelerator utilization the caller's
    responsibility while this module retains deterministic tree accounting.
    Values are from the root player's perspective and must be finite.
    """
    rng = random.Random(config.seed)
    root_actions = list(actions(initial)) if not terminal(initial) else []
    if len(set(root_actions)) != len(root_actions):
        raise ValueError("actions retornou ações duplicadas")
    root = _Node(initial, None, None, root_actions, {})
    completed = 0
    while completed < config.simulations:
        batch_count = min(config.batch_size, config.simulations - completed)
        paths: list[list[_Node[State, Action]]] = []
        leaves: list[State] = []
        for _ in range(batch_count):
            node, path, depth = root, [root], 0
            while not terminal(node.state) and depth < config.max_depth:
                if node.unexpanded:
                    choice = rng.randrange(len(node.unexpanded))
                    action = node.unexpanded.pop(choice)
                    state = transition(node.state, action)
                    available = list(actions(state)) if not terminal(state) else []
                    if len(set(available)) != len(available):
                        raise ValueError("actions retornou ações duplicadas")
                    child = _Node(state, node, action, available, {})
                    node.children[action] = child
                    node = child
                    path.append(node)
                    break
                if not node.children:
                    break
                logarithm = math.log(max(1, node.visits))
                node = max(
                    node.children.values(),
                    key=lambda child: (
                        child.value_sum / child.visits
                        + config.exploration * math.sqrt(logarithm / child.visits)
                        if child.visits else math.inf,
                        repr(child.action),
                    ),
                )
                path.append(node)
                depth += 1
            paths.append(path)
            leaves.append(node.state)
        values = list(evaluate(leaves))
        if len(values) != len(paths):
            raise ValueError("evaluate deve devolver um valor por estado")
        for path, raw_value in zip(paths, values):
            value = float(raw_value)
            if not math.isfinite(value):
                raise ValueError("evaluate devolveu valor não finito")
            for node in path:
                node.visits += 1
                node.value_sum += value
        completed += len(paths)
    statistics = tuple(sorted(
        (ActionStatistic(action, child.visits, child.value_sum / child.visits)
         for action, child in root.children.items() if child.visits),
        key=lambda item: (-item.visits, -item.mean_value, repr(item.action)),
    ))
    return MCTSResult(statistics[0].action if statistics else None, completed, statistics)


__all__ = ["ActionStatistic", "MCTSConfig", "MCTSResult", "batch_mcts"]
END FILE: src/nablamath/gpu/batch_mcts_kernel.py

"""F4 building block: exact modular row reduction of Macaulay matrices.

The public API accepts an optional backend implementing the same contract.  The
reference path is deterministic CPU code; an accelerator must identify itself in
the returned receipt, preventing silent CPU/GPU attribution errors.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import hashlib
import json
from typing import Protocol, Sequence


class ModularRrefBackend(Protocol):
    name: str
    accelerated: bool

    def modular_rref(self, matrix: list[list[int]], prime: int) -> tuple[list[list[int]], list[int]]: ...


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class F4ReductionResult:
    matrix: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    pivots: tuple[int, ...]
    prime: int
    rank: int
    backend: str
    accelerated: bool
    content_id: str


def _is_prime(value: int) -> bool:
    if value < 2:
        return False
    if value % 2 == 0:
        return value == 2
    divisor = 3
    while divisor * divisor <= value:
        if value % divisor == 0:
            return False
        divisor += 2
    return True


def _cpu_rref(matrix: list[list[int]], prime: int) -> tuple[list[list[int]], list[int]]:
    if not matrix:
        return [], []
    rows, columns = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
    pivot_row = 0
    pivots: list[int] = []
    for column in range(columns):
        candidate = next((row for row in range(pivot_row, rows)
                          if matrix[row][column] % prime), None)
        if candidate is None:
            continue
        matrix[pivot_row], matrix[candidate] = matrix[candidate], matrix[pivot_row]
        inverse = pow(matrix[pivot_row][column] % prime, -1, prime)
        matrix[pivot_row] = [(value * inverse) % prime for value in matrix[pivot_row]]
        for row in range(rows):
            if row == pivot_row:
                continue
            factor = matrix[row][column] % prime
            if factor:
                matrix[row] = [(value - factor * pivot) % prime
                               for value, pivot in zip(matrix[row], matrix[pivot_row])]
        pivots.append(column)
        pivot_row += 1
        if pivot_row == rows:
            break
    return matrix, pivots


def modular_rref(
    rows: Sequence[Sequence[int]],
    prime: int,
    *,
    backend: ModularRrefBackend | None = None,
    cell_limit: int = 10_000_000,
) -> F4ReductionResult:
    """Reduce a rectangular integer matrix over ``GF(prime)`` exactly."""
    if type(prime) is not int or not _is_prime(prime):
        raise ValueError("O módulo deve ser primo")
    if type(cell_limit) is not int or cell_limit < 1:
        raise ValueError("cell_limit deve ser positivo")
    matrix = [list(row) for row in rows]
    columns = len(matrix[0]) if matrix else 0
    if any(len(row) != columns for row in matrix):
        raise ValueError("Matriz precisa ser retangular")
    if len(matrix) * columns > cell_limit:
        raise MemoryError("Matriz F4 excede o orçamento de células")
    matrix = [[int(value) % prime for value in row] for row in matrix]
    if backend is None:
        reduced, pivots = _cpu_rref(matrix, prime)
        backend_name, accelerated = "cpu-reference", False
    else:
        reduced, pivots = backend.modular_rref(matrix, prime)
        backend_name, accelerated = backend.name, bool(backend.accelerated)
        if len(reduced) != len(matrix) or any(len(row) != columns for row in reduced):
            raise RuntimeError("Backend devolveu matriz com shape incompatível")
        reduced = [[int(value) % prime for value in row] for row in reduced]
        # Independently verify the claimed RREF instead of trusting a device kernel.
        verified, verified_pivots = _cpu_rref([row[:] for row in matrix], prime)
        if reduced != verified or list(pivots) != verified_pivots:
            raise ArithmeticError("Backend acelerado divergiu da redução modular exata")
    payload = {"matrix": reduced, "pivots": pivots, "prime": prime,
               "backend": backend_name, "accelerated": accelerated}
    content_id = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True,
                                           separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()
    return F4ReductionResult(tuple(tuple(row) for row in reduced), tuple(pivots), prime,
                             len(pivots), backend_name, accelerated, content_id)


__all__ = ["F4ReductionResult", "ModularRrefBackend", "modular_rref"]

"""Small auditable INT8 linear policy for ranking symbolic actions."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math
from typing import Sequence


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QuantizedLinearGuide:
    """Symmetric per-tensor INT8 policy with deterministic integer accumulation."""

    actions: tuple[str, ...]
    weights: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]
    biases: tuple[int, ...]
    weight_scale: float
    feature_scale: float

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.actions or len(set(self.actions)) != len(self.actions):
            raise ValueError("Ações devem ser únicas e não vazias")
        if len(self.weights) != len(self.actions) or len(self.biases) != len(self.actions):
            raise ValueError("Uma linha de pesos e bias é exigida por ação")
        width = len(self.weights[0]) if self.weights else 0
        if width < 1 or any(len(row) != width for row in self.weights):
            raise ValueError("Matriz de pesos deve ser retangular e não vazia")
        if any(not -127 <= value <= 127 for row in self.weights for value in row):
            raise ValueError("Pesos precisam caber em INT8 simétrico")
        if not all(math.isfinite(scale) and scale > 0
                   for scale in (self.weight_scale, self.feature_scale)):
            raise ValueError("Escalas devem ser finitas e positivas")

    @property
    def feature_count(self) -> int:
        return len(self.weights[0])

    @classmethod
    def quantize(cls, actions: Sequence[str], weights: Sequence[Sequence[float]],
                 biases: Sequence[float] | None = None, *, feature_scale: float = 1 / 127) -> QuantizedLinearGuide:
        rows = [list(map(float, row)) for row in weights]
        if not rows or any(len(row) != len(rows[0]) for row in rows):
            raise ValueError("Matriz de pesos inválida")
        maximum = max((abs(value) for row in rows for value in row), default=0.0)
        weight_scale = maximum / 127 if maximum else 1.0
        quantized = tuple(tuple(max(-127, min(127, round(value / weight_scale)))
                                 for value in row) for row in rows)
        raw_biases = list(biases or [0.0] * len(rows))
        accumulator_scale = weight_scale * feature_scale
        quantized_biases = tuple(round(value / accumulator_scale) for value in raw_biases)
        return cls(tuple(actions), quantized, quantized_biases, weight_scale, feature_scale)

    def logits(self, features: Sequence[float]) -> tuple[float, ...]:
        if len(features) != self.feature_count:
            raise ValueError("Número incorreto de features")
        if any(not math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in features):
            raise ValueError("Features devem ser finitas")
        quantized_features = tuple(max(-127, min(127, round(float(value) / self.feature_scale)))
                                   for value in features)
        scale = self.weight_scale * self.feature_scale
        return tuple((sum(weight * feature for weight, feature in zip(row, quantized_features)) + bias)
                     * scale for row, bias in zip(self.weights, self.biases))

    def rank(self, features: Sequence[float]) -> tuple[tuple[str, float], ...]:
        return tuple(sorted(zip(self.actions, self.logits(features)),
                            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0])))


__all__ = ["QuantizedLinearGuide"]
